official.deadline_central_display: Open for applications - no closing date published
official.deadline_note: ANU publishes no closing date for this award because there is no separate scholarship application: consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
official.application_cycle: Continuous - considered automatically with each admissions application
official.status_note: The ANU scholarship page shows the application period as 'Open for applications' with no closing date, because no separate scholarship application is required.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Value: 20% off your first-year tuition fees, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester for the one year of the award.
benefits: 20% off your first-year tuition fees, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester.
Payment made for 1 year; the duration of the Award is one year.
No separate scholarship application: all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the university will be automatically considered.
The value of the Award is stated in the letter of offer.
eligibility: You are a new commencing student, or a continuing student who has received an offer of admission to a higher AQF level of studies; eligible study levels are Undergraduate/Bachelor, Honours, Postgraduate/Masters and Graduate certificate, and selection is based on academic merit.
You hold residential status in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea, or The Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Undergraduate applicants must meet a Selection Rank of 85 (or equivalent as determined by the University) or above; postgraduate applicants a minimum GPA of 5.5 (or equivalent).
You are not the recipient of an external sponsorship that covers all or part of your tuition fees at the University.

You acknowledge that the award can be offered only once at each level of study, except where you progress from an undergraduate degree (AQF Level 7) to a one-year Honours program (AQF Level 8), or accept a packaged offer such as a Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's degree.
requirements: Any eligible program EXCEPT the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE).
There is no need to apply for the scholarship; all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the university will be automatically considered.
You must accept both your academic offer and your scholarship offer separately.
The recipient is responsible for making payment of all tuition fees by the prescribed date as set out by the University each session.

Only applicants who meet all the eligibility criteria will be considered; qualifications are converted to the common scale and eligible applicants with multiple qualifications are ranked according to the qualification used as the basis of admission.
documents: No separate scholarship application or scholarship document is required; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
The ANU admission application itself, submitted through the 'Apply now' button on the scholarship page.
The scholarship offer letter, which states the value of the Award and must be accepted separately from the academic offer.
selection_criteria: Selection is made based on academic merit.
Qualifications submitted for admission to the University are converted to the common scale, which determines whether an applicant is eligible for the Award.
Eligible applicants with multiple qualifications are ranked according to the qualification used as the basis of admission.
coverage: 20% off your first-year tuition fees, applied towards tuition at the start of each semester across the one year of the Award.
Recipients are responsible for the costs of books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study.
application_method: Choose an eligible program; the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE) are excluded.
Press the 'Apply now' button on the scholarship page to start the ANU Admissions application process.
Submit the admission application - there is no separate scholarship application and eligibility is assessed automatically.
Receive the academic offer and, if selected, a separate scholarship offer stating the value of the Award.
Accept the academic offer and the scholarship offer separately.
Pay your share of the tuition fees by the prescribed date set out by the University each session.
official.application_route: Apply for admission through the ANU admissions process; there is no separate scholarship application and consideration is automatic.
official.citizenship_residency: Eligibility is by residential status, not citizenship, and is restricted to China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea and The Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
official.international_eligibility: International students only; residents of countries outside the published list should apply to the separate ANU International Achievement Award, which ANU publishes with values of 20% for Undergraduate, 20% for Postgraduate, 25% for South East Asia and 50% for Pacific.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any eligible program except the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE).
official.description: The ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award is funded by The Australian National University, whose stated objective is to attract a diverse range of academically capable overseas students to enrol in undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs offered by the University.

english_requirement - no English language requirement is published on the scholarship page
deadline_central - ANU publishes no closing date; consideration is automatic with the admissions application
deferral, renewal, return-home obligations, clinical restrictions and tax treatment - these are governed by the Conditions of Award (63/2026) PDF, which could not be opened from the scholarship page
verification.notes: The ANU scholarship page was read in full on the University's own domain. The 20% first-year tuition value, the one-year duration, the country list, the Selection Rank 85 / GPA 5.5 thresholds, the MChD and MDTE exclusions, the automatic-consideration route and the 'responsible for books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study' statement were all confirmed directly.

applicant_utility.summary: There is nothing to apply for here: you are considered automatically through your admissions application, so the only thing you control is making your admissions application as strong as possible and accepting the academic and scholarship offers separately when they arrive. It is worth 20% of first-year tuition only, not a full scholarship, and it ends after one year, so plan for years two onwards from your own funds. It is also restricted to residents of China, Japan, Mongolia and the two Koreas, and it is void if any external sponsorship covers even part of your ANU tuition.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving applicants resident in China, Japan, Mongolia or Korea applying for an eligible ANU undergraduate, honours, graduate certificate or postgraduate coursework program with no external tuition sponsorship.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your residential status is one of the listed countries or regions before relying on this award.
Check your target program is not the MChD or the MDTE - both are excluded outright.
Aim above the thresholds rather than at them: Selection Rank 85 or equivalent for undergraduate, GPA 5.5 or equivalent for postgraduate.
Make sure no external sponsor is paying any part of your ANU tuition, which would disqualify you.
Treat the admissions application as the scholarship application and submit it early enough to be considered for the intake.
When the two offers arrive, accept the academic offer and the scholarship offer separately, and keep the scholarship offer letter - it states the value.
common_rejection_risks: Holding external sponsorship that covers all or part of your ANU tuition fees.
Applying for the MChD or MDTE, which are excluded programs.
Just missing the Selection Rank 85 or GPA 5.5 thresholds - selection is purely on academic merit with no interview or additional statement to offset a weaker transcript.
Assuming the award applies at every level: it can be offered only once at each level of study, apart from the Honours and packaged-offer exceptions.
Being a resident of a country outside the published list, for which the separate ANU International Achievement Award applies instead.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: 80% of first-year tuition and the whole of second year onwards, plus books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study. ANU states explicitly that recipients are responsible for these.
document_audit: There is no scholarship document to prepare, so the risk sits entirely in the admissions application and its evidence.
The value is not published as a figure - it is stated in the letter of offer, so read that letter carefully rather than budgeting from the web page.
Two acceptances are required: the academic offer and the scholarship offer, and they are separate steps.
The governing document is the Conditions of Award (63/2026) PDF linked from the scholarship page, which contains the conditions the web page only summarises.
alerts: The award lasts one year only, so fee relief stops after your first year.

It can be offered only once at each level of study, except for progression from an undergraduate degree to a one-year Honours program or a packaged offer such as a Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's.
No closing date is published, which reflects the automatic-consideration route rather than an open-ended opportunity - your admissions timing is effectively your deadline.

If your residential status is outside the listed countries, the separate ANU International Achievement Award is the right target, with published values of 20% undergraduate, 20% postgraduate, 25% South East Asia and 50% Pacific.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: You submit an admissions application through the ANU admissions process, ANU assesses eligibility automatically against residential status, academic thresholds and program eligibility, issues an academic offer and, if selected, a separate scholarship offer stating the value, which you accept independently of the academic offer.
